tagline: Steel products cut to size and delivered across Tashkent
niche: Steel yard: box section, sheet, rebar, angle

listing.description: A website for a steel yard or steel stockist: a price table by section, cutting and delivery services, and quote requests to Telegram.

seo.title: Metall Ombor — steel products in Tashkent with delivery
seo.description: Box section, sheet, rebar, angle and channel from our yard in Sergeli. Cutting to size, bending and same-day crane-truck delivery. We sell from a single length.
seo.answer: Metall Ombor is a steel yard in Sergeli, Tashkent: box section from 26,000 UZS per metre, 2 mm sheet from 520,000 UZS, rebar from 11,900,000 UZS per tonne. We cut to size, bend and deliver by crane truck the same day. Open Mon–Sat 8:00–18:00, phone +998 71 200-07-01.

sections.title: We deliver steel
sections.subtitle: Box section, sheet, rebar and angle from our own yard. We cut to your list, load it and bring it by crane truck — the same day if you order before 1 pm.

sections.label: About the yard
sections.title: An open yard and a cutting shop on one site
sections.text: Our yard in Sergeli keeps the common stock on hand: box section from 15×15 to 120×120, sheet from 0.5 to 10 mm, rebar and merchant bar. A band saw, guillotine and press brake stand next to it, so your order leaves already cut. We sell to homeowners building one canopy and to crews supplying a site.

sections.label: Services
sections.title: Cut, bent, delivered
sections.intro: Everything needed for the steel to arrive ready to weld.

items.title: Cutting to size
items.text: Band saw, ±2 mm accuracy. Up to 10 cuts per item free.

items.title: Sheet bending
items.text: Flashings, boxes and angles to your sketch, up to 3 m long.

items.title: Crane-truck delivery
items.text: Same-day within Tashkent, crane unloading onto your plot.

items.title: Primer coating
items.text: GF-021 primer on box section and angle, dry within a day.

sections.label: How to order
sections.title: Four steps to steel on site

items.text: Send a list or drawing on Telegram — even a photo of a notebook page works.

items.title: Quote
items.text: Within 30 minutes we price weight, cutting and delivery as one sum.

items.title: Payment
items.text: Cash, card or bank transfer with VAT for companies.

items.title: Delivery
items.text: We cut, load and deliver, unloading wherever suits you.

items.quote: Ordered box section for a canopy in the morning; by lunch it was on my plot, cut to my list.
items.author: Botir

items.quote: We buy rebar for our sites. The weight checks out and the paperwork arrives the same day.
items.author: Dilshod

items.q: Can I buy just one length?
items.a: Yes, we sell single lengths and even offcuts at the per-metre price.
By crane truck within Tashkent from 250,000 UZS; the total depends on district and weight.
Yes — VAT invoices, shipment on power of attorney and reconciliation statements.
Prices move with the steel market; we confirm the exact total when we quote your order.
